full_page.content:
1932, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 45 Page 46
Blank Page
June Wm. & Charles Lennane - mental trouble - parents asks prayers. Mrs. Theresa Pajot - 63 - internal cancer
Mrs. Bertha Ferrell (56) 1457 Harding - a cath. 22 yrs. coming here for failing sight. This is no better as yet - one eye gone entirely - had cancer of leg Dr's wanted to cut it off ... now perfect ....
Raymond Ma. Sabourin - 17 - invalid 15 yrs. At 2 had a fall - in- fantile paralisis, scarlet fever .... cripple ever since.
Mrs. Stella (Jos.) Ryan of Uniontown, Pa. - now in Receiving Hospital - mental .... lost husband 4 years ago after 3 yrs. agony - now her property - has 3 boys 16 - 3 - 8
Patricia Jones - 6 - tumorous groth in side.
Mrs. R. Carpenter - 88 last Sunday - cancer
Robert Girourd (6) operation on blind eye to-morrow. .. . ..
Page 47
Blank Page
June 24 29
Mrs. Alice Stafford - 44 - breast Cancer - Mrs. Alice Stafford 221 S. Chalmers -enrolled last Friday(June 24) perpetually of cancer of breast .... Husband reports To-day (29) "Very much improved"- Enrolls her again for the Poor Souls in Thanksgiving.
Rose Devine - 59 - near Ottawa - Eye trouble
Dorothy Hamlin - 18 - Northville T.B.
Joseph P. Muhvich - 6 - Epileptic now in Lapeer - can only say Mama .... Harry Schaefer - 12 - an invalid more or less since birth, was in acci- dent-week-age - and got badly burned.
Baby Edw'd Rosinski - 10 months old O.K. after abcess - mastoid. Thanks ... Deo Gr.
Wanda Zuk - 3 - deaf & dumb - could talk till about two months ago - had been having convulsions.
Mrs. Mier - Goiter - daughter cured of asthma and apendicitis, boy ear trouble
